name: [UPD] Build a Garden Tower
desc:
Welcome to Build a Garden Tower!
See how high your garden tower can go!

🌱 Buy Plants and Grow them
• Get the rarest plants and build the tallest tower!

💰Sell your harvest for cash
• Max out your crates and make money!

🚀 Upgrade Your Tower Farm
• Get more floors and more building space!

💾 All your progress saves!
Available for PC, Mobile, and Console
